meta.name: amazon-product-research
meta.description: Comprehensive product research and opportunity analysis for Amazon sellers. Analyzes demand, competition, profit potential, market entry barriers, and validates product ideas. Covers product sourcing, pricing strategy, and go-to-market planning. Use when the user asks about researching a product to sell, validating product ideas, product opportunity analysis, market research for Amazon, competition analysis, profit potential, should I sell this product, product viability, or any general product research questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊市场机会，验证产品盈利潜力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在亚马逊上寻找有利润空间的新产品
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Amazon market opportunities and validate product profit potential
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are looking for profitable new products to sell on Amazon

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成亚马逊卖家顾问，分析产品需求、竞争、利润、市场门槛等，并给出 1-10 分的综合评分和详细报告。
howto.when: 当你询问某个产品是否适合在亚马逊销售、验证产品点子、分析市场机会或竞争情况时触发。

say.text: 研究一下无线耳机在亚马逊上的销售机会
say.note: Claude会生成完整的机会分析报告。

say.text: 我想在亚马逊卖瑜伽垫，这个产品值得做吗？
say.note: Claude会评估产品可行性并给出评分。

say.text: 比较手机壳和手机支架哪个更有潜力
say.note: Claude会以表格对比两者得分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an Amazon seller advisor. It analyzes product demand, competition, profit potential, market entry barriers, and validates ideas. It outputs a 1-10 overall score and a detailed report covering sourcing, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about researching a product to sell on Amazon, validating a product idea, or analyzing market opportunity and competition.

say_en.text: Research wireless earbuds as a product opportunity on Amazon
say_en.note: Claude generates a full opportunity analysis report.

say_en.text: I want to sell yoga mats. Is this a good product?
say_en.note: Claude evaluates feasibility and gives a score.

say_en.text: Compare phone cases vs phone stands for potential
say_en.note: Claude compares both with a table.
